en.title: Echoes of the Strike Zone
en.premise: In the sleepless city of Minato-wan, Minato—a genius pitcher haunted by misfortune—embarks on the final chapter of his baseball career following a definitive falling-out with his twin brother, Kai. Against the backdrop of the city's relentless bustle, Minato leads a team on the brink of collapse in a desperate bid for the national championships. The searing wind on the mound, the grip of the seams against his fingertips—a high-stakes battle begins, where every single pitch feels like a gamble with his very life.

zh.title: 残响的击球区
zh.premise: 在不夜之城——凑湾市，怀才不遇的天才投手凑在与双胞胎弟弟海决裂后，开始了自己棒球生涯的最后征程。背对着城市的喧嚣，凑率领着一支濒临废部的球队，向全国大赛发起冲击。投手丘上感受到的热风，指尖深深陷入的缝线。每一球都仿佛在燃烧生命，一场极尽激烈的攻防战就此拉开序幕。
